subject: croatian
summary: Croatian text renders correctly with all its accented letters, question wording is clean, and each attached reading text is the right article for the card, sharp and free of other questions. Short vocabulary cards are fine. The weak part is the scheme on anything longer: the official sample answers are pasted in as paragraph-length tick boxes (a 5-mark question gets seven of them, a 30-mark commentary gets one box holding a whole essay), each preceded by small grey commentary about what the scheme document 'prints' and 'heads'. One essay card shows 'The scheme prints no answer for this part' with a 0-40 button grid. On a phone the long cards run to well over two screens-columns of dense text; desktop is more comfortable but still a wall.

issues.title: Sample answers pasted in as giant tick boxes
issues.detail: Card 5 (5 marks) shows seven tick boxes of first-person sample-answer prose, the first 28 lines long on a phone; card 2 (30 marks) is one tick box containing a whole sample essay. The instruction 'Tick each part you completed' does not fit example answers, there are no marks per box, and nothing says they are alternatives rather than a required list except a grey note.
issues.suggested_fix: Present as a collapsed 'Sample answer from the scheme' block (not tick boxes), with a short list of the ideas it contains for self-checking; show how the 5 or 30 marks are awarded.

issues.title: Grey commentary about the scheme inside the first box
issues.detail: Each scheme starts with small grey text such as 'The examination requires every answer in CROATIAN. The paper prints the rule on page 2: "..." The scheme heads its answer "Na primjer:": what it gives is an example, not a required list.' It sits inside the first tick box above the real content and reads like an internal note.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove it; replace with a plain label 'Example answer' where needed and state the language rule once per subject.

issues.title: 'No answer' essay card
issues.detail: Card 3 shows 'The scheme prints no answer for this part.' under 'Select the points you actually got', a grey paragraph, then 41 number buttons (0-40). No criteria are offered to mark against.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the general essay criteria, change the heading, and use a slider or bands instead of 41 buttons.

issues.title: Paragraph references look like marks; scheme rows unlabelled
issues.detail: Card 4 lists 'a) kompleksnih (2)  b) pohranjen (3)  c) dvolične (10) ...' on a 5-mark question; the bracketed numbers are paragraph numbers in the text but read as marks. The five scheme rows are not labelled a) to e) and carry no '1m' badges.
issues.suggested_fix: Write '(odlomak 2)' / '(par. 2)', prefix each scheme row with its letter and term, show 1 mark each.

issues.title: Term or author run onto the instruction
issues.detail: Card 1 reads '...sljedeće pojmove: predanost' with the term in the same type as the instruction; card 3 keeps 'on one of the following topics' with one title and the attribution after a stray '. -'.
issues.suggested_fix: Put the term/quotation on its own line; attribution on a separate line.

good_examples.why: One-line question, one-line answer, right text attached.
Parts a) to e) listed one per line and five short scheme rows (needs letters and the grey note removed).
